system.description: Your deceptive powers are so great they can alter your halo. Those who use Soulsight see what you want them to see. By expending Blood Traits, you can alter the appearance of your halo, telling a false story to creatures with Soulsight or similar abilities. One Trait lets you lie about whether you are telling the truth and your emotional state; two Traits let you claim to be a ghoul, mortal or even a Lupine; three Traits let you lie about whether you are under the influence of magic or have committed diablerie, or hide your halo entirely. This power cannot conceal the Assamite clan weakness and lasts one scene. Only Cainites who know Elder-level Auspex may attempt to see through this deception; if you have no levels of Auspex yourself, you cannot change your halo's appearance, only suppress it.
